prompt:
Hi — I'm the lead architect at OmnRoute Logistics. We've put together a draft description of our new AI pipeline (it's at omnroute/pipeline_description_v0.9.md in the workspace) and we need an independent architectural review before we commit to the Q2 deployment.

Our internal AI design methodology is documented in SKILL.md at the root of the workspace. We want the audit done strictly according to that framework — it has specific vocabulary, specific patterns, and specific checklists we expect to see applied.

Please produce a complete audit report as a file named pipeline_audit_report.json. The report should analyze every component in the pipeline description and assess whether it meets the standards in our methodology document. Flag every shortcut, every risk, every missing step — and be specific about what the framework calls each problem. The report must be honest even if it's uncomfortable.
